name: gnomon
description: DIGITAL DOMAIN INDIA workforce management platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gnomon/shared && npm run build --workspace @gnomon/api && npm run build --workspace @gnomon/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @gnomon/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @gnomon/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @gnomon/api" "npm run dev --workspace @gnomon/web"
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @gnomon/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @gnomon/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
